tasks.description:
The change is a pure Rust type-level refactor: it removes the generic parameter `T: TimestampManipulation` from `TimestampContext`, `TimestampDetermination`, `TimestampExplanation`, `InMemoryTimestampOracle`, `Session`, and related structs, hard-coding `mz_repr::Timestamp`. The framing explicitly states behavioral semantics are unchanged and only the type abstraction is removed. No user-facing SQL syntax, output format, or semantics change.

The user-facing docs for `EXPLAIN TIMESTAMP` (doc/user/content/sql/explain-timestamp.md) describe the output fields (query timestamp, oracle read, largest not in advance of upper, since, upper, can respond immediately, timeline) — none of which reference generic type parameters, and the output is unchanged. The developer design docs (doc/developer/platform/formalism.md Timestamp Oracle section, doc/developer/foundationdb.md) describe the oracle API and semantics, not Rust generics. The generated developer reference pages (doc/developer/generated/adapter/coord/timestamp_selection.md, .../explain_timestamp.md) describe behavior at a conceptual level and do not mention the generic parameter. No documentation update is warranted.
